description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling certificate applications, including submitting new applications, viewing user-specific applications, listing applications for review, reviewing individual applications, and updating application statuses with relevant authorization and notification logic.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles the submission of a new certificate application by a patient.

methods.name: router.get('/mine')
methods.description: Allows a patient to view all their submitted applications.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Allows doctors and admins to list all pending applications.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Retrieves a specific application by ID for review.

methods.name: router.patch('/:id')
methods.description: Allows doctors/admins to approve or reject an application.
